user.title: Jarvis Host
user.description: Adds the Mac that runs Home Assistant as a device. The Mac sends its own status; Home Assistant never connects to it.

data_description.name: How the device is called, for example Mac mini.
data_description.model: Leave empty to use the model the Mac reports.

url.title: Webhook address
url.description:
Let the Mac post its report to this address:

`{url}`

The address is secret: anyone on your network who knows it can send reports. If you reach Home Assistant through a proxy or another port, change the host and port to match. It is shown again later under Configure.

abort.already_configured: This Mac is already set up.

init.description:
